Pin format: the operator pin / desired model is the persisted string `model|configId=value|configId2=value2`; parse it with `ajax_core::adapters::parse_model_selection(raw: &str) -> Option<ajax_core::adapters::ModelSelection>` where `ModelSelection { pub model: String, pub options: Vec<(String, String)> }` (options are (configId, value) pairs). `super::is_unspecified_model(raw: Option<&str>) -> bool` is true for empty / "default"-like values. A parse failure (None) means: apply nothing. For Pi the model value is "provider/id" and the only option id that means anything is "thought_level".
